verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
verses.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

verses.ar: أُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّبَّ فِي حَيَاتِي، وَأُرَنِّمُ لِإِلَهِي مَا دُمْتُ مَوْجُودًا.
verses.kjv: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.web: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
verses.he: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעֹודִֽי׃

verses.ar: لَا تَتَّكِلُوا عَلَى ٱلرُّؤَسَاءِ، وَلَا عَلَى ٱبْنِ آدَمَ حَيْثُ لَا خَلَاصَ عِنْدَهُ.
verses.kjv: Put not your trust in princes, [nor] in the son of man, in whom [there is] no help.
verses.web: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
verses.he: אַל־תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־אָדָ֓ם ׀ שֶׁ֤אֵֽין לֹ֥ו תְשׁוּעָֽה׃

verses.ar: تَخْرُجُ رُوحُهُ فَيَعُودُ إِلَى تُرَابِهِ. فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ نَفْسِهِ تَهْلِكُ أَفْكَارُهُ.
verses.kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.web: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
verses.he: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחֹו יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָתֹ֑ו בַּיֹּ֥ום הַ֝ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِمَنْ إِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ مُعِينُهُ، وَرَجَاؤُهُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِهِ،
verses.kjv: Happy [is he] that [hath] the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope [is] in the LORD his God:
verses.web: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,
verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּעֶזְרֹ֑ו שִׂ֝בְרֹ֗ו עַל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

verses.ar: ٱلصَّانِعِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ، ٱلْبَحْرَ وَكُلَّ مَا فِيهَا. ٱلْحَافِظِ ٱلْأَمَانَةَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein [is:] which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.web: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֤ה ׀ שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעֹולָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلْمُجْرِي حُكْمًا لِلْمَظْلُومِينَ، ٱلْمُعْطِي خُبْزًا لِلْجِيَاعِ. ٱلرَّبُّ يُطْلِقُ ٱلْأَسْرَى.
verses.kjv: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
verses.web: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.
verses.he: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט ׀ לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَفْتَحُ أَعْيُنَ ٱلْعُمْيِ. ٱلرَّبُّ يُقَوِّمُ ٱلْمُنْحَنِينَ. ٱلرَّبُّ يُحِبُّ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD openeth [the eyes of] the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
verses.web: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.
verses.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَحْفَظُ ٱلْغُرَبَاءَ. يَعْضُدُ ٱلْيَتِيمَ وَٱلْأَرْمَلَةَ، أَمَّا طَرِيقُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَيُعَوِّجُهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.web: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
verses.he: יְהוָ֤ה ׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־גֵּרִ֗ים יָתֹ֣ום וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעֹודֵ֑ד וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃

verses.ar: يَمْلِكُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، إِلَهُكِ يَا صِهْيَوْنُ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever, [even] thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
verses.he: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לְעֹולָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יֹּון לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
